facts.fact: Moyna 抢先抓走粉笔盒，自己承认多半是出于小气
facts.anchor: She snatched up the box mostly out of pettiness.

facts.fact: 小组商定：Alys 负责病史并开始诊断；拿着粉笔的 Moyna 统筹治疗，除非病例她不熟悉
facts.anchor: They agreed amongst themselves that Alys would take the history and start diagnostics

facts.fact: 考卷只写：治好这名病人的伤，且不得使用镇静剂
facts.anchor: Heal this patient’s injury. You will not have access to sedation tonics.

facts.fact: Luisa 的脚踝是三年前从树上摔下时摔断的，愈合花了很久，至今仍疼且僵硬
facts.anchor: The ankle had been badly broken three years ago in a fall from a tree

facts.fact: Alys 报 Luisa 心跳变慢后，Moyna 听 Clement 数到三，把自己的魔法收回体内，转去接手监测并给心脏起搏
facts.anchor: Moyna took her magic back within herself, waited for the three, and—out.

facts.fact: 治疗成功后，Luisa 抓起拐杖往墙上砸，直到拐杖裂开
facts.anchor: picking up her crutch and smashing it against the wall until it splintered

facts.fact: Jehan 承认自己曾跟 Ysabel 谈过很多研究，她还要求他示范这项手法
facts.anchor: I told you, we talked about my research a lot. She asked me to show her how to do it.

facts.fact: 邮局账本显示，那批延迟投递的信件由某人付了款，付款人至少署名 Ysabel Caudotte
facts.anchor: paid for by someone who’d at least signed themself Ysabel Caudotte
